description: This file defines the SpendLogCleanup class, which handles cleaning up old spend logs from a database based on retention policies. It includes methods for determining if logs should be deleted, deleting old logs in batches asynchronously, and managing distributed locks to ensure only one instance runs cleanup at a time.

classes.name: SpendLogCleanup
classes.description: A class responsible for cleaning up old spend logs in the database, ensuring retention policies are respected and using distributed locking to prevent concurrent cleanup processes.
